title: Chaos Control Remix
native_title: カオス・コントロール・リミックス
overview:
In the year 2050, the alien Kesh Rhan invade Earth. As Jessica Darkhill of the Orbital Defence Forces, newly promoted to Major, you fly out to meet the invaders, starting over Manhattan and the Statue of Liberty before carrying the fight into space, past the space colony Solaris and on to the enemy flagship.

Your fighter follows a set course, so your job is to move the targeting sight and shoot down enemy craft, timing your fire so your guns do not overheat. A second player can fight alongside you, and you can continue from partway through a stage.

- 3D shooting for 1 or 2 players
- 8 stages over Manhattan and in space
- Virtua Gun and Shuttle Mouse compatible
